'''April 2001 Findlay tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Findlay, OH on 14 April 2001. Craig won it. It is known from Brad Eier's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2107">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-18-findlay-ohio-4-14-01d2107/ findlay-ohio-4-14-01], DeckTech (brad "swccguy" eier, 18 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-18-findlay-ohio-4-14-01d2107/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 14 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Findlay, OH
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' Craig
